column1: # Custom 4 MB partition table for Heltec V2 KNOCK-OFFs that ship with 4 MB
# Winbond flash instead of the genuine 8 MB. Same factory + OTA pattern as
# partitions.csv but ONE OTA slot instead of two
# V2.3.15 binary is ~1.18 MB; 1.875 MB per slot leaves ~37 % headroom — same
# percentage as the 8 MB layout's 2 MB slots
# Tail at 0x3E0000-0x400000 (128 KB) reserved (could be used for spiffs/littlefs
# if a future feature wants on-device persistent storage).
